# One-Step

> Student guidance for studying in Malaysia, including university comparisons, tuition fee charts, scholarships and application planning for international students, including applicants from Bangladesh.

One-Step is a student guidance business. University offers, current official fee schedules and government requirements determine admission, payments and visa outcomes. A page update is not a new verification of every underlying fee or ranking.
